title: Bober River Flow
tagline: Play as a mighty beaver flowing through the river and avoiding logs.
description: This project uses my own Enclave Phaser Template to make a fun little game that would end up as a Farcaster miniapp utilizing the Celo challenge. I did get the contract published on the Sepolia testnet eventually, but I couldn't go any further because of issues with GitHub Pages.
how_its_made: Uses the Phaser game engine for rendering, my own Enclave Phaser Template on top of it, and it tried going for the Celo challenge with the help from GitHub Copilot, but it didn't go very well as I had some issues deploying it on GitHub Pages. An attempt was made, but clearly this entry is not going to win anything. I tried though!
